effects.name: Divine Smite
effects.description: When you hit with a melee weapon attack, you may use a Bonus Action and a spell slot to add Radiant damage.

macro.name: Divine Smite
macro.author: Zl1BOUaPLwDEujaL

description.value:
The target takes an extra 2d8 Radiant damage from the attack. The damage increases by 1d8 if the target is a Fiend or an Undead.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 1.

midi-qol: Uses a transfer effect that registers a DamageBonusMacro on the actor. On any melee weapon hit, the macro prompts to use Divine Smite, lets the player choose a spell slot level, consumes the slot, and adds (1+level)d8 Radiant damage (max 5d8). Adds 1d8 extra vs Fiends and Undead. Critical hits are handled via isCritical on the DamageRoll. No separate cast required — the prompt appears automatically on melee hits.
description.chat:

activation.condition: Immediately after hitting a target with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike
